name: Cocos (Keeling) Islands
prevalence_note: Western Australia Consumer Protection delivers consumer services in the Indian Ocean Territories under a Service Delivery Arrangement, and tells Christmas and Cocos residents to report scams to WA ScamNet. The same office issued a 'Look out for scams' poster in Cocos Malay, which shows targeted local education rather than a loss table broken out for the atoll.
cross_border_note: The atoll uses Australia's +61 plan with Indian Ocean Territories prefixes, so caller ID can look like a mainland Australian number. Advice may need to be adjusted once the caller says they are phoning from the Cocos (Keeling) Islands, as the WA office itself requests.

scams.name: WA ScamNet phishing that pretends to be a bank or service provider
scams.name_en: Phishing, as described by WA ScamNet for territories served by WA Consumer Protection, seeking passwords or card data after a fake account alert

red_flag_keywords.text: customer records wiped by a technical error
quote the three-digit code on the card
log in on this recovery site

scams.signals_en: WA ScamNet describes an out-of-the-blue email, text, social-media message or call that copies a bank or utility's branding, claims a foreign purchase or a lost customer file, and then asks the person to confirm a password, account number or card security code, sometimes on a look-alike web address.
scams.legit_en: Australian banks and the WA service do not ask Territory residents to hand over a card security code or password in an unexpected message. A real check starts from the organisation's published website or from WA ScamNet, not from the link in the message.
bait_tactics: Say a Home Island or West Island household will only use the contact path printed by WA Consumer Protection for the Indian Ocean Territories.
Ask which Australian bank or provider is supposedly calling, then look the number up independently rather than ringing back the displayed caller ID.
Mention that a Cocos Malay official poster already tells residents to treat unexpected requests for personal data as suspect, and decline to read anything aloud from a text.
